source.author: ov
source.text: iure igitur virgo est, quae semina nulla remittit nec capit et comites virginitatis amat.
source.text_original: iure igitur virgo est, quae semina nulla remittit / nec capit et comites virginitatis amat.
source.text_english: Therefore she is rightly a maiden, who neither gives forth nor receives any seed, and loves the companions of maidenhood.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: iure igitur uirgo est, quae semina nulla remittit nec capit, et comites uirginitatis amat.
reuse.text_original: iure igitur uirgo est, quae semina nulla remittit nec capit, et comites uirginitatis amat.
reuse.text_english: Therefore she is rightly a virgin, who neither releases nor receives any seeds, and loves the companions of virginity.
